title: Samādhi
text: 1. Sāvatthi || la || || 2. Samādhim bhikkhave bhāvetha || || Samāhito bhikkhave bhikkhu yathābhūtam pajānāti || || Kiñca yathābhūtam pajānāti || || 3. Idam dukkhan ti pajānāti || ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti yathābhūtam pa- || ayam dukkhanirodho ti yathābhūtam pa- || ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || || 4. Samādhim bhikkhave bhāvetha samāhito bhikkhave bhikkhu yathābhūtam pajānāti || || Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idam dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo || Ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti yogo karanīyo || Ayam dukkhanirodho ti yogo karaṇīyo || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo || ||
